note: Rewritten from Krishna & Araujo's (1968) description of the new species; the original is in English. The material begins in mid-sentence at the top of p. 100 ("erceptible." being the tail of "imperceptible" from the preceding page); the passages describing the soldier's head capsule, labrum and mandibles lie outside the material, so this entry contains only the three sentences on the mesonotum, metanotum and midtibia together with the measurements of TABLE 4, plus the comparison and type data; the measurements cover only two columns, holotype and 1 paratype.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier has a prominent spine-like process on the anterior part of the head; among the species with this process it is closest to N. angusticeps and N. parvus, but both of those are larger in all measurements. In N. parvus the cephalic spine-like process is less prominent, the lateral lobes of the labrum project more, the mandibles are much shorter relative to the head capsule, and the head/mandible index (left mandible length/head length) is 0.65 (0.85 in the present species). Type locality: Fazenda Piedade, about 100 km south of Ilha do Bananal, Goiás, Brazil; only 2 soldiers (holotype and paratype), collected by Peter Kaiser. The holotype is in the American Museum of Natural History and the paratype in the Department of Zoology, São Paulo, Brazil. The species name derives from the Araguaia River.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Lateral margins of the mesonotum rounded and projecting, posterior margin straight. Metanotum as wide as the pronotum, lateral margins rounded, posterior margin broadly angulate. Outer margin of the midtibia with 1 spine near the middle, slightly stouter than an ordinary seta. Measurements (mm; holotype, paratype): head-capsule lateral length 2.24, 2.24; maximum head width 1.20, 1.17; maximum head height 1.02, 1.02; left mandible length 1.94, 1.86; right mandible length 1.79, 1.79; maximum postmentum width 0.41, 0.41; minimum postmentum width 0.20, 0.20; postmentum length 1.63, 1.58; pronotum mid-length 0.56, 0.56; minimum pronotum length 0.56, 0.56; maximum pronotum length 0.59, 0.56; maximum pronotum width 0.77, 0.74; hindtibia length 0.97, 0.97.
